organization.fullName: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology

identificationModule.briefTitle: Enzalutamide With or Without Abiraterone and Prednisone in Treating Patients With Castration-Resistant Metastatic Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Trial of Enzalutamide (NSC# 766085) Versus Enzalutamide, Abiraterone and Prednisone for Castration Resistant Metastatic Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm A: (enzalutamide)
armGroups.description: Patients receive enzalutamide 160 mg PO QD. Treatment will continue until confirmed disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm B: (enzalutamide, abiraterone, prednisone)
armGroups.description: Patients receive enzalutamide 160 mg PO QD, abiraterone 1000 mg PO QD, and prednisone 5 mg PO BID. Treatment will continue until confirmed disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
